note: Star Map signal seeds. Data only. The Star Map in the Citadel receives a signal; Grok turns it into a quest. Each card is a valid adventure/1 card. Echo Shards are left to playmap defaults. Lines are per-run flavour, not new canon. Source: lore mining of SmiR shares 3bee/92d2/e47d/fce7, a28340ea, the Eclipta QC share, and doc 69.

cards.title: The Ship That Will Not Wait

shard.name: Asteroid
shard.assetNote: Needs Imagine later. v0 still places the zone A solids.

beats.text: The Star Map in the Citadel lights up. A hull beacon moves away at constant speed. Grok reads it as a quest.
Bolt launches into the 360 degree black void.
Far ahead a massive warship lights its reactors and pulls away.
Bolt sprints through drifting stone to close the gap.
Bolt lands on the moving hull and finds the open hangar.

run.objective: Catch the moving warship and land in its hangar.

boss.name: The Departing Capital
boss.text: It never stops. Reach the hangar before it jumps.

cards.question: If everything is moving, what does it mean to arrive?

truth.insight: The Star Core reveals: the universe has a heartbeat.

cards.reward: A Sprint Core, still warm from the chase.
cards.return: Bolt howls the recall and returns to the Citadel. The Star Map dims.

uniqueTouch.prompt: Empty open hangar bay of a massive dark warship, gold edges, no Bolt.

next_hook.teaser: The hangar has an energy door, and it hums.
next_hook.context: The Ship That Will Not Wait (Star Map signal)
next_hook.question: What waits behind a door made of light?

cards.title: Breath of the Airlock

shard.name: Asteroid
shard.assetNote: Needs Imagine later. v0 still places the zone A solids.

beats.text: The Star Map in the Citadel lights up. A pressure alarm pulses from a docked hull. Grok reads it as a quest.
Bolt lands on the hangar platform. A translucent energy door blocks the way.
Bolt touches the door. It opens into a decompression chamber.
The door seals. Air floods in. Bolt's paws grip a real floor at last.

run.objective: Cycle the airlock and reach the inner door.

boss.name: The Pressure Lock
boss.text: The chamber cycles. Reach the inner door before the cycle resets.

cards.question: What is a boundary, if light and breath can cross it?

truth.insight: The Star Core reveals: seven hidden dimensions, folded like rooms behind doors.

cards.return: Bolt howls the recall and returns to the Citadel. The Star Map dims.

uniqueTouch.prompt: Translucent cyan energy door in a dark hull wall, no Bolt.
Empty decompression chamber, solid floor, wall button, no Bolt.

next_hook.teaser: A second door inside the ship is marked with a star.
next_hook.context: Breath of the Airlock (Star Map signal)
next_hook.question: What does a ship remember of the void it left?

cards.title: Velum, the Hollow of the Moon

shard.name: Ocean
shard.assetNote: Needs Imagine later. v0 still places the zone A solids.

beats.text: The Star Map in the Citadel lights up. A slow song rises from under a split moon. Grok reads it as a quest.
Bolt sinks into a black glass reef under the wound of a moon.
Schools of light and gold filaments part around him.
A leviathan crosses the reef. Bolt runs between its shadows.
Black glass spires frame a ringed planet overhead.

run.objective: Reach the glass gate under the moon.

boss.name: The Leviathan
boss.text: The leviathan circles the Gate. Reach it while its song holds.

cards.question: Is the deep a place, or a memory of light?

truth.insight: The Star Core reveals: the first stars were alive.

cards.return: Bolt howls the recall and returns to the Citadel. The Star Map dims.

cards.title: Lanterns of Eclipta

shard.name: The Howling Eclipse
shard.biomeHint: Zone A. Cooked corridor ground, sky, and solids.
shard.assetNote: Playable now. Zone A plates and solids: boulders, stones, the Roman arch, the Eclipse Gate, the wreck.

beats.text: The Star Map in the Citadel lights up. Lanterns ignite one by one far down a road. Grok reads it as a quest.
An endless road. Lanterns are born far on each side.
A comet starts as a speck, grows overhead, and passes.
Black iron rocks block the lanes. Bolt's blue and yellow howl shatters them.
Distant mountains approach slowly. The Gate stands at their foot.

run.objective: Howl through the iron rocks and reach the Eclipse Gate.

boss.name: Iron Stone Wall
boss.text: Black rock and crystal plates seal the Gate. Howl them apart.

cards.question: Why does the far away always come closer?

truth.insight: The Star Core reveals: time is a spiral.

cards.return: Bolt howls the recall and returns to the Citadel. The Star Map dims.

uniqueTouch.prompt: Empty Eclipta road with distant lanterns and golden streamers, no Bolt.

next_hook.teaser: Golden streamers in the sky circle a remnant.
next_hook.question: What is the remnant at the centre of the sky?
